person.name: Yiheyis Tamir Ayalew
person.title: Software Engineer
person.summary: Software Engineer specializing in backend and mobile development, with hands-on experience building scalable APIs using Go, Python, and Node.js with Clean Architecture principles. Skilled in developing cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter and integrating them with RESTful services. Experienced with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, and CI/CD workflows. Contributed to production fintech systems and end-to-end feature delivery.

education.institution: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University (AASTU)
Africa to Silicon Valley (A2SV) - Backed By Google
highlights: Learned advanced algorithms, including graph, tree, and memoization-based techniques.
Solved over 600 LeetCode and Codeforces problems to enhance coding efficiency.

responsibilities: Built 30+ REST API endpoints in Go with Gin to power blog content creation, search, and AI-assisted recommendations, enabling efficient content management for writers and readers.
Applied Clean Architecture to structure a multi-layered codebase, improving scalability and maintenance.
Produced 65+ Go backend APIs to connect Flutter mobile and React clients, creating a unified ecosystem for restaurants and customers.
Introduced OCR to digitize physical menus, transforming static menu images into searchable, structured digital data for easier customer access.

projects.name: Bayment - FinTech Virtual Card & P2P Platform
details: Full-Stack FinTech App: Engineered a Django REST backend and Flutter mobile UI for a live payment platform.
Virtual Cards: Implemented features to instantly issue, manage, freeze, and unfreeze global virtual cards.
P2P Payments: Architected peer-to-peer funding flows integrated with local African bank systems.
Play Store Release: Deployed the production app to Google Play, ensuring compliance and data security.

projects.name: Smart Helmet - Safety & Health Monitoring System
projects.role: Integrated Engineering Project, IoT, Embedded Systems, Emergency Alert System
details: Transformed a wearable IoT helmet that monitors heart rate, oxygen levels, and body temperature in real time, with automated alerts for anomalies to support safer transport and healthier communities (aligned with SDG 3 and SDG 11).
Integrated IoT sensors with a microcontroller for continuous monitoring and wireless data transmission to connected devices.
Conducted three rounds of simulated and field testing to improve sensor reliability, minimize false alerts, and validate system performance.

projects.name: Virtual Home Rental APP
details: Crafted a mobile application that helps users search and explore rental properties, featuring 3D panoramic views and Google-Maps integration with distance-based filters (1-5 km).
Unified Firebase Firestore to provide real-time property listings and updates, ensuring smooth search-to-booking workflows tested by early users.
Implemented secure authentication with Firebase Auth and included payment features to protect user data and manage transactions across 150+ property listings.

projects.name: Disease Prediction & Medical Recommendation System
details: Engineered an ML-driven healthcare system capable of predicting 41 distinct diseases based on 132 symptom inputs.
Integrated lifestyle-based medical recommendations and guidance into the application workflow.

projects.name: Cashless Taxi Payment & Navigation Assistant
details: Architected and managed microservices across authentication, digital wallet, QR code processing, messaging, and payment services.
Enhanced transaction tracking in the wallet service to include sender details and resolved security and API gateway routing configurations.

achievements: Secured 2nd place at the Hackatom Hackathon (hosted by a Russian university) by crafting a Flutter/Dart mobile app and website to promote nuclear energy awareness, standing out among international competitors.
